paragraphs: Shashna. Rav Dimi bar Shashna. Gittin 62b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Gittin 62b follows סב: under the colon convention; this is Hyman’s locator, without independent edition-specific verification.
Shashna is a conventional vocalization of ששנא, listed in Rav Dimi bar Shashna. The title רב is explicit; this parent-name listing does not provide further identification.
